definition_en: to put something together with another thing, or to join numbers
core_image: 把牛奶倒进面粉里
scene: 厨房里，妈妈把牛奶倒进面粉里。She added milk to the flour.
sceneCN: 这里 added 是「添加」（第 1 个义项：把一物加到另一物里）；句意为她把牛奶加进面粉里。

pos.zh: 动词：添加；增加；相加；补充说

senses.title: To put one thing with another
senses.definition: to put something together with something else
senses.definitionCN: 把某物与另一物放在一起
senses.example: Add some sugar to the tea.
senses.why: Add comes from Latin addere, to give to, so the first picture is giving one thing to another.
senses.whyCN: add 来自拉丁语 addere「给到」，最初的画面就是把一物给到另一物上。

senses.title: To join numbers
senses.definition: to join numbers to find a total
senses.definitionCN: 把数字合起来求出总数
senses.example: If you add three and four, you get seven.
senses.why: Numbers are treated like a pile, and joining them is adding one amount to another.
senses.whyCN: 数目被看成一堆东西，把两堆合起来就是相加。

senses.title: To say more
senses.definition: to say something more after what was said
senses.definitionCN: 在已说过的话之后再补充
senses.example: She added that the shop was closed.
senses.why: Words are also added: a further remark is put after the first one.
senses.whyCN: 话也可以被「加上」：在原先的话后面再放一句，就是补充说。

senses.title: To make a quality stronger
senses.definition: to put in something that increases a quality
senses.definitionCN: 加入某物使某种性质增强
senses.example: A lamp added warmth to the room.
senses.exampleCN: 一盏灯给房间增添了温暖。
senses.why: A quality can be increased by putting something into the scene, as a lamp adds warmth.
senses.whyCN: 把某物放进环境里让某种性质变强，就是增添。

definition_en: the place where someone lives, or a speech, or to deal with a problem
core_image: 信封上写着一行清楚的地址
scene: 信封上写着一行清楚的地址。The address on the envelope was easy to read.
sceneCN: 这里 address 是「地址」（第 1 个义项：住址或所在地）；句意为信封上的地址很容易看清。

pos.zh: 名词：地址；演说；称呼
动词：处理；对……讲话；写地址

senses.title: The place where someone lives
senses.definition: the details of where a person or a place is
senses.definitionCN: 关于某人或某处所在位置的详细信息
senses.example: Write your address on the form.
senses.exampleCN: 把你的地址写在表格上。
senses.why: Ad- means toward and the old French verb meant to direct, so pointing words toward a place gives the sense of an address.
senses.whyCN: ad- 表示「向」，古法语动词意为「指向」，把住处指向一个地方，就是地址。

senses.title: A formal speech
senses.definition: a speech made to a group on an occasion
senses.definitionCN: 在某个场合对一群人发表的讲话
senses.example: The head gave an address to the school.
senses.exampleCN: 校长对全校发表了讲话。
senses.why: Pointing a speech toward a whole group gives the formal sense of an address.
senses.whyCN: 把一段话指向整个群体，就是正式的演说。

senses.title: A way of speaking to someone
senses.definition: the words used when speaking or writing to a person
senses.definitionCN: 对某人说话或写信时使用的称谓
senses.example: The letter began with a polite address.
senses.exampleCN: 这封信以礼貌的称呼开头。
senses.why: The words one directs at a person are that person's address in speech.
senses.whyCN: 对人说出的称谓，就是称呼方式。

senses.title: To deal with a problem
senses.definition: to take action about a problem
senses.definitionCN: 针对某个问题采取行动
senses.example: The school must address the noise problem.
senses.exampleCN: 学校必须处理噪音问题。
senses.why: Pointing one's attention at a problem is the modern sense of dealing with it.
senses.whyCN: 把注意力指向问题，就是处理问题。

senses.title: To speak to a group
senses.definition: to make a speech to a group of people
senses.definitionCN: 对一群人发表讲话
senses.example: The mayor addressed the crowd.
senses.why: Pointing one's voice at a crowd is the verb sense of speaking to them.
senses.whyCN: 把声音直指人群，就是对人群讲话。

definition_en: to think highly of someone or something, or to enjoy looking at it
core_image: 同学们围着画展上的作品赞叹
scene: 画展上，同学们围着作品连声赞叹。They admired the painting for a long time.
sceneCN: 这里 admired 是「欣赏」（第 1 个义项：带着敬意与喜爱看某物）；句意为他们欣赏这幅画很久。

pos.zh: 动词：钦佩；赞赏；欣赏；仰慕

senses.title: To think highly of someone
senses.definition: to respect a person and think well of them
senses.definitionCN: 敬重某人并看好他
senses.example: We admire her courage.
senses.why: The Latin verb meant to wonder at, and wondering at a person turns into respect and admiration.
senses.whyCN: 拉丁动词意为「对……惊叹」，对一个人惊叹，就转为敬重与钦佩。

senses.title: To enjoy looking at something
senses.definition: to look at something with pleasure
senses.definitionCN: 愉快地观看某物
senses.example: They admired the old bridge.
senses.why: Wonder can also be felt before a beautiful thing, which gives the sense of enjoying a view or an object.
senses.whyCN: 惊叹也可以落在美好的事物上，于是有了欣赏某物的意思。

senses.title: To praise someone
senses.definition: to speak with praise about a person
senses.definitionCN: 带着赞美谈论某人
senses.example: The teacher admired his neat work.
senses.exampleCN: 老师称赞他整洁的作业。
senses.why: Wondering aloud becomes praise, so admire can mean speaking well of someone.
senses.whyCN: 把惊叹说出口，就变成称赞某人。

senses.title: To look at a view
senses.definition: to stand and look at a wide view
senses.definitionCN: 停下来观看开阔的景色
senses.example: We stopped to admire the sea.
senses.why: Stopping to let the eyes rest on a wide view is the act of admiring a scene.
senses.whyCN: 停下脚步让目光停在开阔的景色上，就是观赏。

definition_en: something that puts a person in a better position or brings a benefit

senses.whyCN: 这个词来自法语短语「在前面」，所以第一义是处在别人前头的优势。

senses.title: A helpful condition

senses.example: A quiet room is an advantage for study.
senses.exampleCN: 安静的房间对学习是有利条件。
senses.why: A thing that puts one in front is a helpful condition, which gives the second sense.
senses.whyCN: 能让人处在前头的事物，就是有利条件。

senses.title: A benefit

senses.definitionCN: 某事物带来的好结果

senses.why: What places one ahead also brings good results, and that is a benefit.
senses.whyCN: 让人处在前头的东西也会带来好结果，这就是好处。

senses.whyCN: 把机会变成自己的前头位置，就是 take advantage of「利用」。

definition_zh: 建议；劝告；通知；提供咨询
definition_en: to tell someone what you think they should do, or to inform them formally

scene: 老师俯下身，给学生的下一步学习提出建议。The teacher advised him to read the chapter twice.

senses.title: To suggest what to do
senses.definition: to tell someone what you think they should do

senses.title: To warn against something

senses.exampleCN: 我劝你不要在暴风雨里外出。
senses.why: The same act with a warning in it becomes telling someone not to do something.
senses.whyCN: 同一个动作带上警告，就变成劝某人不要做某事。

senses.title: To tell someone formally
senses.definition: to give someone information in an official way
senses.definitionCN: 以正式方式把消息告诉某人

senses.why: In offices and letters, the act of giving information is the formal sense of telling someone.
senses.whyCN: 在办公室与信件里，把消息给对方的动作就是正式通知。

definition_en: to have enough money or time for something, or to provide something

scene: 商店里，女孩拿起价格牌，算了算自己的钱够不够。We cannot afford a new bike this year.
sceneCN: 这里 afford 是「负担得起」（第 1 个义项：有足够的钱做某事）；句意为今年我们买不起新自行车。

pos.zh: 动词：负担得起；抽得出；承受得起；提供

senses.title: To have enough money
senses.definition: to have enough money for something
senses.definitionCN: 有足够的钱用于某物
senses.example: We cannot afford a new car.
senses.why: The old verb meant to put forward or to supply, and having enough to supply the cost became the sense of being able to pay.
senses.whyCN: 古动词意为「推进、供应」，拿得出所需的钱，就成了买得起。

senses.title: To have enough time or strength
senses.definition: to have enough time or strength for something
senses.definitionCN: 有足够的时间或力气应付某事
senses.example: Can you afford the time for a trip?
senses.exampleCN: 你抽得出时间去旅行吗？
senses.why: The same idea of having enough was applied to time and strength, not only to money.
senses.whyCN: 「拿得出」不只用在线钱上，用在时间与力气上，就是承担得起。

senses.title: To provide something
senses.definition: to give or supply something, in a formal style
senses.definitionCN: 以正式语体给出或供应某物
senses.example: The trees afford welcome shade.
senses.exampleCN: 这些树提供了宜人的阴凉。
senses.why: The oldest sense of supplying something survives in a formal style.
senses.whyCN: 最古老的「供应」义保留在正式语体里，就是提供。

definition_en: feeling fear, or worried, or sorry to say something
core_image: 孩子在黑屋子里靠近妈妈

senses.definition: feeling fear about something

senses.example: The child is afraid of the dark.

senses.whyCN: afraid 由古英语表示「受惊」的词构成，第一义就是单纯的害怕。

senses.title: Worried about something
senses.definition: feeling worry that something bad may happen
senses.definitionCN: 担心可能发生不好的事
senses.example: I am afraid for her health.
senses.why: Fear pointed at what may happen becomes worry rather than terror.
senses.whyCN: 把害怕指向可能发生的不幸，就从惊恐变成担心。

senses.title: Used to soften bad news
senses.definition: used politely before bad or unwelcome news
senses.definitionCN: 在不好的消息前用作客气的开场
senses.example: I am afraid he is late.
senses.why: The worry was softened into a polite opening, which is the sense of I am afraid.
senses.whyCN: 把担心弱化成客气的开场语，就是「恐怕」。

senses.title: As a further point

senses.title: Opposed to something

senses.whyCN: 身体与墙面对面贴住，就是靠着。

senses.title: In a contest with
senses.definition: competing with another team or player
senses.definitionCN: 与另一队或选手竞争

senses.exampleCN: 他们与另一所学校比赛。
senses.why: Two sides facing each other in a game are playing against each other.
senses.whyCN: 两方在比赛中面对面较量，就是与……比赛。

senses.title: As protection from
senses.definition: used for something that protects from a danger
senses.definitionCN: 用于抵御某种危险

senses.why: Something placed face to face with a danger to block it gives the sense of protection against.
senses.whyCN: 把某物挡在危险前面，就是防、逆着。

definition_en: how old someone or something is, or a period of history, or being old
core_image: 生日蛋糕上插着蜡烛
scene: 生日那天，蛋糕上插着十二根蜡烛。She is twelve years of age.
sceneCN: 这里 age 是「年龄」（第 1 个义项：活了多少年）；句意为她十二岁。

senses.title: How old someone is
senses.definition: the number of years a person or a thing has lived
senses.definitionCN: 人或事物已经存在的年数
senses.example: She is twelve years of age.
senses.why: Age comes from Latin aetas, the length of a life, so it first means the number of years one has lived.
senses.whyCN: age 来自拉丁语 aetas「生命的长短」，先指一个人活了多少年，就是年龄。

senses.title: A period of history
senses.definition: a long period of history with a shared character
senses.definitionCN: 具有共同特征的一段长历史时期
senses.example: The age of steam changed the world.
senses.why: The same length is put on a whole society, which gives the sense of a historical age.
senses.whyCN: 把这种长度放到整个社会上，就成了历史的时代。

senses.title: To grow old
senses.definition: to become older
senses.definitionCN: 变得年长
senses.example: Worry can age a person.
senses.why: The noun became a verb for the process of gaining years.
senses.whyCN: 名词转为动词，指年岁增长的过程，就是变老。

senses.title: A very long time
senses.definition: used in ages for a long time in speech
senses.definitionCN: 口语中用于 ages，表示很长时间
senses.example: We have not met for ages.
senses.why: In speech, many years are stretched into the plural ages for a very long time.
senses.whyCN: 口语把许多年拉长成复数 ages，就是很久。

definition_en: a person who acts for another, or a thing that produces an effect
core_image: 一位经纪人在电话里替客户谈生意
scene: 办公室里，一位经纪人正在电话中替客户洽谈。The agent sold the house for us.

pos.zh: 名词：代理人；经纪人；特工；作用剂

senses.title: A person who acts for another
senses.definition: a person who does business for someone else
senses.definitionCN: 替别人办事的人
senses.example: The agent sold the flat for the owner.
senses.exampleCN: 代理人替房主卖掉了公寓。
senses.why: Agent comes from Latin agere, to do, so an agent is simply a person who does something for another.
senses.whyCN: agent 来自拉丁语 agere「做」，替别人做事的人就是代理人。

senses.title: A person who manages work
senses.definition: a person who finds work or deals for an actor or a player
senses.definitionCN: 为演员或选手找机会、谈事务的人
senses.example: Her agent found her a role in a film.
senses.exampleCN: 她的经纪人替她找到电影角色。
senses.why: In films and sport, the person who does the dealing for a performer is an agent.
senses.whyCN: 在影视与体育里替表演者谈事务的人，就是经纪人。

senses.title: A force that causes change
senses.definition: a thing that produces an effect
senses.definitionCN: 产生某种作用的事物
senses.example: Wind is an agent of change in the desert.
senses.exampleCN: 风是沙漠中促成变化的因素。
senses.why: The doing was widened to any force that acts, which gives the sense of a factor.
senses.whyCN: 把「起作用者」扩到任何产生作用的力量，就是因素。

senses.title: A secret worker for a state
senses.definition: a person who works secretly for a government
senses.definitionCN: 为政府秘密工作的人
senses.example: The agent carried a small radio.
senses.exampleCN: 那名特工带着一台小收音机。
senses.why: A person who acts secretly for a state is the modern sense of a secret agent.
senses.whyCN: 为国家秘密做事的人，就是现代意义的特工。

definition_en: to share the same opinion, or to say yes, or to match something

senses.definition: to come to a shared decision after talking

senses.example: The two sides agreed on a price.
senses.why: When both sides move to one mind about a deal, they reach an agreement.
senses.whyCN: 双方谈到同一个意上，就是达成一致。

senses.title: To match a fact
senses.definition: to be the same as another account or fact
senses.definitionCN: 与另一种说法或事实一致
senses.example: The two accounts do not agree.
senses.why: The idea of being of one mind was applied to facts, so matching accounts agree.
senses.whyCN: 把「合」用在说法与事实之间，就是相符。

senses.title: To say yes to a plan
senses.definition: to accept a plan or a suggestion

senses.why: Saying yes to a plan is the everyday form of being of one mind with it.
senses.whyCN: 对一项计划说好，就是日常语境里的赞成。

senses.title: To suit the body

senses.why: In health talk, a food that suits the body is said to agree with a person.

definition_en: in front, or earlier in time, or further forward
core_image: 跑道前方领先的选手
scene: 跑道上，一名选手跑在队伍的最前面。The team is ahead by two points.
sceneCN: 这里 ahead 是「领先」（第 1 个义项：处在别人前面）；句意为这支队伍领先两分。

pos.zh: 副词：在前面；提前；领先；向前

senses.title: In front
senses.definition: in a position in front of someone or something
senses.definitionCN: 在某人或某物前面的位置
senses.example: The road ahead was clear.
senses.why: Ahead is a plus head, and the head is at the front, so the word pictures being at the front of a line.
senses.whyCN: ahead 由 a 与 head 构成，头所在的位置就是队伍的前面。

senses.title: Earlier in time
senses.definition: before the expected time
senses.definitionCN: 在预定的时间之前
senses.example: We arrived ahead of the crowd.
senses.why: Being in front was applied to time, where it means earlier than expected.
senses.whyCN: 把「在前面」用到时间上，就是比预期更早。

senses.title: Leading in a contest
senses.definition: in front in a race or a competition
senses.definitionCN: 在比赛或竞争中处在前面
senses.example: The team is ahead by two points.
senses.why: In a race, the one in front is the one leading.
senses.whyCN: 在比赛中处在前面，就是领先。

senses.title: Forward
senses.definition: onward in the direction one faces
senses.definitionCN: 朝面对的方向继续
senses.example: Move ahead slowly.
senses.why: Moving in the direction the head faces is moving forward.
senses.whyCN: 朝头所对的方向走，就是向前。

definition_en: the gas we breathe, or the sky, or a manner, or to broadcast
core_image: 早晨窗口吹进来的清风
scene: 清晨，窗户打开，一阵清风进来。The air was fresh.
sceneCN: 这里 air 是「空气」（第 1 个义项：我们呼吸的气体）；句意为空气很清新。

pos.zh: 名词：空气；天空；神态；曲调
动词：播出；晾晒；公开发表

senses.title: The gas we breathe
senses.definition: the gas around us that we breathe
senses.definitionCN: 我们周围供呼吸的气体
senses.example: Open the window and let in some air.
senses.why: Air comes from Latin aer, the gas of the atmosphere, so its first sense is what we breathe.
senses.whyCN: air 来自拉丁语 aer，直接指大气里的气体，所以第一义是我们呼吸的空气。

senses.title: The space above the ground
senses.definition: the open space above the earth
senses.definitionCN: 地面上方的开阔空间
senses.example: The plane rose into the air.
senses.why: The same gas fills the space overhead, which gives the sense of the air above us.
senses.whyCN: 同样的气体充满头顶的空间，就有了「空中」义。

senses.title: A manner or look
senses.definition: the way a person looks or behaves
senses.definitionCN: 一个人的样子或举止给人的感觉
senses.example: She had a happy air.
senses.why: A person's mood seems to spread out like air, so air came to mean a manner or look.
senses.whyCN: 人的情绪像空气一样散发出来，air 于是指神态。

senses.title: A simple tune
senses.definition: a simple melody
senses.definitionCN: 简单的旋律
senses.example: The band played a simple air.
senses.exampleCN: 乐队演奏了一支简单的曲调。
senses.why: Old music words used air for a flowing melody, as if it moved like air.
senses.whyCN: 古音乐用语把流动的旋律叫作 air，仿佛它像空气一样流动。

senses.title: To broadcast
senses.definition: to send a programme out for people to hear or watch
senses.definitionCN: 把节目放出去供人收听或观看
senses.example: The school will air the film tonight.
senses.exampleCN: 学校今晚会播出这部电影。
senses.why: A programme is sent out into the air, so the verb air means to broadcast.
senses.whyCN: 节目被送到空气里传播，动词 air 就成了播出。
